svg.title: Two private frontends, one pair of web servers
svg.desc: A tunnel client can curl agw-web's private frontend, through nsg-appgw, or lbi-web's frontend fe-web; both spread requests over pool-web, vm-web1 and vm-web2 on port 80. The gateway's public IP has no listener, and nsg-appgw must also let GatewayManager in on TCP 65200-65535.
